title: Lesson 24 · A Telegram bot from any device

lines.sub: This is Lira's Academy, lesson twenty-four — “A Telegram bot from any device”.
lines.tts: This is Lira's Academy, lesson twenty-four — A Telegram bot from any device.

lines.sub: I'm on the road and my laptop at home is off. Lira, what do I have tomorrow?
lines.tts: I'm on the road and my laptop at home is off. Lira, what do I have tomorrow?

lines.sub: At ten — the dentist, at three — a call with Anna. The laptop is asleep — your phone answered.
lines.tts: At ten — the dentist, at three — a call with Anna. The laptop is asleep — your phone answered.

lines.sub: The bot now belongs to your account, not to one computer: all your devices know it.
lines.tts: The bot now belongs to your account, not to one computer: all your devices know it.

lines.sub: The computer you talked to last answers. The others stand by.
lines.tts: The computer you talked to last answers. The others stand by.

lines.sub: One message — one answer, no duplicates.
lines.tts: One message — one answer, no duplicates.

lines.sub: Computers off — the phone answers. And if nobody's online — I'll answer from the server.
lines.tts: Computers off — the phone answers. And if nobody's online — I'll answer from the server.

lines.sub: In the studio — “Connection”, the Telegram card: it shows who is answering right now.
